resources.name: Tight-binding parameters for GaSb, AlSb, InAs (two-band model)

access.notes: The paper Rahmani, Masri, Dobrzynski, J. Phys. C 21, 4761 (1988) provides the orbital self-energies E1i, E2i and hopping integrals γ_i for GaSb, AlSb, InAs, as well as interfacial hopping parameters and lattice constant.
